messages.content: What is the best month to visit Hawaii?

function.name: get_average_monthly_temperature

message.content:
The “best” month to visit Hawaii really depends on what you’re looking for—weather, crowds, price, or activities—but most travelers find that **April, May, September, October, or November** strike the best balance.

| What you want | Best months |
|---------------|-------------|
| Warm, sunny weather & low rainfall | December–March (but crowds are high) |
| Mild temperatures, lower crowds & better deals | April, May, September, October, November |
| Great surf & cooler temperatures | Winter months (December–February) |

If you’re after a relaxed vacation with pleasant temperatures and fewer tourists, **late spring (April–May)** or **early fall (September–October)** are usually the sweet spots. These periods offer comfortable temperatures (mid‑70s °F / 24–26 °C), lower humidity, and more affordable accommodation rates compared to the peak summer season.
